LanguageData.FB_GastricAcidSpewer_ToggleDesc: Spread gastric fluid onto suitable cells near the organ.\n\nWhen switched off, the organ draws fluid back from the edge farthest from all spewers. If other spewers still feed the shared pool, this organ removes only as many cells as it filled. Once every spewer is off, the entire pool is drained.

LanguageData.FB_ShowColonyTendrilCaptureZoneDesc: Show the colony cargo tendril zone: inside the bright border they pick up, deliver and move freely, the faint rim is how far they still stretch on the way, and beyond it they never set foot.
